metadata.scope: Recover the staging /profile 'セッション情報を取得できませんでした / 通信経路でセッション確認に失敗しました' failure in one implementation cycle. The on-screen wording itself is the MEMBER_SESSION_FAILED (transport-level throw) branch introduced by PR #1194 (merged to dev 2026-06-10), so the deployed staging bundle is recent and 410/5xx/stale-bundle hypotheses are excluded by the user-provided evidence. Remaining sub-causes are S1 (transport unresolved throw), S2 (localhost fallback connection failure), S3 (service-binding fetch throw), and S4 (http fetch throw), with two cross-cutting code defects: F-A getAuthEnv all-or-nothing safeParse silently dropping INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL when any unrelated field is invalid, and F-B single-transport dependency with no fallback. The fix is defense-in-depth that recovers under any of S1-S4: T01 integrate the unmerged observability branch fix/profile-session-staging-localhost-endpoint (ApiTransportError{transportKind,baseHost}, describeTransport, environmentExplicit fail-closed, safe-fetch transport logging), T02 make getAuthEnv field-tolerant, T03 add a transport fallback chain (service-binding -> INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL -> NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, only on ApiTransportError and only for GET/HEAD, never on HTTP error responses), and T04 extend the read-only diagnose script (web /api/me and API direct /me probes, data-cause extraction with a user-provided cookie, deploy version check). No /me contract, apps/api, D1 schema, Google Form, or /profile UI wording change. Final sub-cause confirmation and staging recovery verification are user-gated Phase 11 steps.

sub_cause_hypotheses.summary: resolveApiFetch throws 'API transport unresolved' (no binding and no base URL visible at runtime)
Environment unreadable -> treated as local -> localhost:8787 fallback fetch fails in Workers runtime

http transport fetch itself throws (API unreachable / DNS / TLS)

cross_cutting_defects.summary: getAuthEnv all-or-nothing safeParse drops every field (including INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL) when any single unrelated field is invalid
Single-transport dependency: fetchAuthed tries exactly one transport and any transport-level throw becomes MEMBER_SESSION_FAILED
